title: A planned check that guards a module not yet written also guards each function it calls
goal: kb/_self/backlog.md tells a planner that a check importing a module a sibling item creates guards the functions it calls (hasattr) as well as the module (find_spec), so precheck reads a failing premise and not a traceback once the module lands without them. SP-ygsnog4n retrospective: after ST-g52zbsv4 added bench_repro.py, precheck called check 0 of ST-5c2h4o7w and of ST-m25otwlp broken (AttributeError on load_briefs and brief_problems), since their guard printed 'no bench_repro module yet' only while the module was absent.
